spec.summary: 8 ADDED requirements pinning the 14 scoping tests; no MODIFIED/REMOVED (m9-01 schema_version semantics still apply). Word count 645 (under 650 budget). Coverage: happy path, edge cases, legacy compat, error states.

tasks.summary: 16 reviewable work units across 4 phases; dependency graph; commit plan; smoke + tiers; out-of-scope. Mandatory Review Workload Forecast lines present. Single branch off main, 4 atomic conventional commits, 350-500 LoC forecast (Medium 400-line budget risk).

disclosures.R1_m9_02_schema_version_bump: CURRENT_BUNDLE_SCHEMA_VERSION moves 1 -> 2 in m9-02 (D3 R1 in scoping).
disclosures.R2_m9_02_events_count_default: Pre-m9-02 bundles deserialize with events_count: 0 via serde default; chronos-services falls back to events.len() only when events is non-empty.
disclosures.R3_m9_02_public_save_events_not_atomic: save_counterexample_bundle_events is a separate public method (for m9+ callers); the canonical save path uses internal atomic wrapper save_bundle_record_and_events.
disclosures.R4_m9_02_no_new_mcp_tool: counterexample_bundle_events tool stays m9+; m9-02 ships the storage primitive only.
disclosures.R5_m9_02_no_chunk_compression: TraceEvent variable-sized payloads; chunk compression deferred to m9+.
disclosures.R6_m9_02_list_still_deserializes_blob: redb lacks sub-value reads; events: vec![] in the post-m9-02 blob keeps list cheap.
disclosures.R7_m9_02_resave_overwrites_chunks: save drops all prior chunks for bundle_id; m9+ append-only would need separate method.
disclosures.R8_m9_02_no_per_chunk_public_load: load_counterexample_bundle_events_chunk is internal; future MCP tool uses concat-then-paginate.
